method: Toast the coconut in a medium frying pan over medium heat, tossing, for 5-10 minutes until dark brown all over. Grind until fine and a little clumpy.
Meanwhile, toast the rice in a small frying pan over medium heat, tossing, for 5-10 minutes until dark brown. Grind until almost fine.
Wipe out the medium pan and heat the coconut oil. Add the curry leaves and garlic and cook until fragrant, then add the mustard seeds and cook until they pop.
Add the pork, salt, black pepper, ginger, chilli, curry powder, onion and pandan leaf, and cook, tossing, for 2 minutes.
Add the lemongrass and vinegar, then add water until everything is about 80% covered. Simmer on low-medium until the pork is tender, about 30 minutes.
Stir through the blackened rice and coconut until they soak up the moisture, leaving a drier curry.
Serve with rice and a squeeze of lime.
